199768: Treble NYC: Celebrate 30 years of harmony and a cappella with an unforgettable 30th Anniversary performance by Treble NYC, New York City’s premier women’s contemporary a cappella group. Founded in 1996, Treble is the longest-running a cappella group in NYC, bringing their signature sound to stages all across New York City for three decades. This special anniversary concert celebrates Treble’s journey with an all-ages brunch show featuring inventive arrangements, powerhouse vocals, and the unmistakable power of the human voice.

199208: TENET: Tenet opens the 2026-2027 season with a fully-staged performance of Claudio Monteverdi's 'Orfeo,' with projections by designer Camilla Tassi. Can Orfeo's beautiful music move Plutone to release Euridice from the Underworld?
